about: One row per config key the network loader reads, with one verdict each. Rendered to CONFIG_promotion_ledger.md by scripts/ledger_render.py; read by scripts/make_golden_config.py and scripts/config_posture_check.py.

knobs.why: Detached hold of the search's fixed cycles (off, observe, emit). D1 and D2 FAILED; the hold neither reaches nor helps the consumer on this posture; kept default off as a measure-only instrument.
Where the fold takes its units: the epoch search or the AGT lattice ledger. Refused unset under an armed fold, lattice with emit refused; lattice graded only under observe (FCF-3).
Hold sigma per folded row in cycles of its band; 0.003 replaced 0.01 after FCF-1 missed its chi2/K bar. Refused unless positive and finite.
False-refusal level of the per-unit chi-square (2 dof) test, also used by the lattice re-validation; the 1e-6 FCF-2 default carried through FCF-3.
Level of each block's chi-square acceptance test on the held solve; the 1e-4 FCF-2 default carried through FCF-3.
Drop-the-worst-unit refold passes before a failing block stays float for the epoch; the default 3 is the FCF-2 value carried through FCF-3.
Refuses a held solve whose shared estimate moves more than this from the float on any column (m); 0.5 is the FCF-2 default carried through FCF-3.
Admission streak of the fixed-cycle ledger, read whenever the ledger runs (trace_lattice, armed in card IRD's search, or the fold at source lattice); default 10, re-added at FCF-3.
Under source lattice, stops folding a unit the search has not determined for this many epochs; default 0 (off); at 10 and 1 it cut wrong folded epochs to 38 and 30 at 7 to 9 points of coverage.
Writes logs/network_fixed_cycles.csv and network_fixed_cycle_shift.csv (plus the fold's edge CSV at source lattice); requires the fold; solve-inert.
Acknowledgement that a fold emit run is a D1 sim measurement arm; read only by the loader's emit interlock, which also checks every station is a sim fixture. D1 FAILED; emit stays a sim instrument.
RT-service bundle that force-arms a pre-refound toggle set including clock_model (NO-GO); the goldens are the posture. Still read by the loader arming block, the posture rt regime and the manifest.
Reference-frame declaration stamped into the product S-contract (frame= field); empty omits the field with byte-identical output; solve-inert.
Coordinate-epoch declaration stamped into the S-contract (cepoch= field); defaults to the SIF propagation date when SIF fills the roster; solve-inert.
Fills only stations lacking position_ecef from the SIF registry, so inert on the explicit golden rosters; the 6 h DOY-129 arms runs/_rap_sif_*_f6 were census-neutral; no card.
Loader-only advisory: one warning when the declared coordinate epoch is older than this many years at the run date; 0 disables it; solve-inert.
Receiver-clock datum station, pinned per bed in both goldens (S30000SIM, MBAR00UGA); empty takes the roster front. Card DATUM-WANDER: pivot geometry moved the datum-free contrast 2.2x on the sim.
Pins the per-constellation clock pivot (default: sticky lexical auto-pick). Card PAC: G14 pinned cut the field hour-2 common drift from -0.180 to -0.063 m/h, consumer unchanged; not armed.
Cross-station epoch-matching tolerance handed to MultiRinexSync by the network setup; 1.0 s in both goldens (default 0.01); structural, no on/off question.
Runs the Phase-2 log-only DD-fixability search: nothing is written back and the emitted product stays float (Phase 3 NO-GO). It is the integer ladder's search on the sim (cards ARL, IRD).
Bootstrap success-rate floor of the producer search's ILS gate; 0.9999 is the design value, stricter than the user path because a wrong network fix reaches every user.
Minimum ratio-test value (s2/s1) of the producer search's ILS gate, a backstop to the success-rate floor; 3.0 is the design value.
Refuses a fix whose ratio exceeds this (degenerate covariance) in the producer search's ILS gate; 1e4 is the design value.
Per-pair fractional gate of the log-only producer AR search (IlsGateConfig and the decorrelated partial fix); the 0.10 default is the value every ARL rung ran with (no ARL config overrides it).
Partial-AR switch of the log-only producer AR search via IlsGateConfig; the default true is the graded value (netar arm explicit, ARL configs leave it at default).

Decorrelated partial fix inside the log-only producer AR search (ARL rung 0: 5 572 single-signal integers, all correct); products unchanged; armed in the IRD search bundle and required by cycle_basis.
Conditional-sigma bar for reporting a single-signal DD as determined in the decorrelated partial fix; the 0.05 cycle default is the ARL value, non-positive input resets to it.
Per-signal Prim tree DD basis of the log-only producer AR search (ARL), now on filter/NetworkArcGraph; prerequisite of cycle_basis and armed in the IRD search bundle; products unchanged.
Per-baseline block search of the log-only producer AR search (ARL rung 3 and the 300-station arm); prerequisite of cycle_basis, armed in the IRD search bundle; products unchanged.
Suspect-corner mask window of the log-only search (0 = off); the ARL slip set and the IRD bundle arm 10, and the FCF fold Emit refuses without it; products unchanged.
Sticky full-coverage cycle basis of the log-only search (AGT-5): 45 026 / 365 566 settled integers at 60 / 300 stations, 0 wrong; needs tree_basis, decorrelated_partial, block_search; IRD arms it.
Default true validated by the AGT-5 control arm: rebuilding every search lost about 1 800 settled integers (43 230 vs 45 026), none wrong either way; inert without cycle_basis.
Measure-only lattice observatory writing logs/network_ar_lattice.csv and _events.csv; requires cycle_basis; IRD reads the lattice it builds; products unchanged.
First epoch of the log-only producer AR search; the default 10 is the graded value (netar arm explicit, ARL configs leave it at default).
MLAMBDA dimension cap of the log-only search (0 = uncapped); ARL runs uncapped, and its block search's cheap readback applies only without the cap; the 200 cap served the retired netar arm.
Per-DD trace of the log-only producer AR search (logs/network_producer_ar.csv), the truth-join grading instrument of ARL, AGT and IRD on the sim bed; products unchanged.
knobs.posture_why: Sim truth bed with .enable armed only; the IRD search bundle arms it; field rows have no truth to grade against.

knobs.why: Float SD EWL rows bought +0.51 % ev1, below the 0.6 % the DD-chord fold bought (gate 4 failed); its pairs need GPS L5 or Galileo E5b, absent from the dual-frequency goldens.
Arc-maturity gate of the SD EWL rows (clamped to at least 2); default 10.
Per-row sigma floor (the statistic is a variance of the mean); default 0.05 m, clamped positive.
Outlier gate on the SD EWL statistic (skip_big_z); default 0 disables it.
Per-station SD EWL row cap (ApplicationNetworkAssembly.cpp:972); default 0 is unlimited.
Writes logs/network_sd_ewl.csv (and network_sd_ewl_ar.csv with the fix path) only; solve-inert.
Route-B SD EWL integer fix: built, field gate never run; out of scope (lanes return as AB3's new build, no EWL pair in the posture), and FCF refuses it.
Bootstrapped success-rate gate of the SD EWL fix, clamped into (0,1); default 0.999.
Fractional-part gate of the SD EWL fix, clamped into (0,0.5]; default 0.15 cyc.
Per-sample sigma floor of the SD EWL fix decision and fixed rows (amendment A1); default 1.0 m.
Path of the network product file (products.txt); each golden sets its own run path. A structural output input with no on/off question.
Per-epoch flush of the product file for a live tail consumer; byte-neutral by construction, armed by service_mode, nothing gained in batch runs. Unset in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: live-tail and RT consumers need bounded product latency; byte-neutral, and service_mode arms it

knobs.why: Per-station OpenMP fan-out of geometry and measurement assembly (default on); pinned true in both goldens and the parent gate of the parallel_seam / parallel_carry family.
Strict roster-size gate (n_sta > value) for the whole parallel family, silent when it closes; goldens pin 8, below the 59/60-station rosters.
knobs.posture_why: a strict > gate with no warning: a roster at or below it silently serializes seam, carry and parallel ingest

knobs.why: Thread count of the parallel family; parallel_carry partials combine in thread-count order, so a pinned N keeps counters and hashes comparable across runs. Goldens pin 20.
knobs.posture_why: pcarry partials combine in thread-count order; 0 (all cores) makes a counter or hash reference machine-bound

knobs.why: Per-block parallel compute with serial install in fixed block order; byte-identical at 50 and 305 stations, 1.64x per epoch. Pinned true in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: byte-identical compare PASS at 50 and 305 sta; 1.64x epoch cold, toward 2x warm

knobs.why: Parallel dense carry fold, 2.13x wall clock at 20 threads; reassociates to ~1e-4 at the solution, so a reference holds only at the same thread count. Pinned true in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: 2.13x wall clock (48.6 to 22.8 s/ep at 20 thr); reassociates ~1e-4, so record the thread count

knobs.why: Writes the static network_stations.csv roster (id, role, ECEF) once at startup for the worldmap viewer; solve-inert. Default on, goldens on.

Per-(station, satellite) iono CSV from an extra reconstruct sweep; emits the correction x_r, not absolute slant iono (use scripts/sh_vtec.py); its regime needs the SH field, retired as a producer constraint.
Writes network_estimability.csv (EPOCH / DIR / RUN records of the near-null-space spectrum, card DG5); solve-inert. Pinned on in both goldens.
Number of estimability gate evaluations the dump may spend (default 6, the former constant); trace-only and byte-identical.
Clean epochs do not spend the estimability budget, so the dump lands on deficit epochs; trace-only and byte-identical.
Opens the IF-TD slip-event CSV and, with a clock monitor or model armed, network_clock_monitor.csv; solve-inert. Pinned on in both goldens.
Writes raw MW / GF / per-signal slip observables each epoch; computing them is solve-inert and the loader refuses it as a slip-gate authority. Pinned on in both goldens.
Widens network_clock_monitor.csv to every sat-epoch row with nis and mode columns; only under trace_slip_events with a clock monitor or model. Unset in the goldens.
Writes network_anchor_info.csv, the per-satellite information fraction of the a-priori clock anchor (B7); the anchor fold is unchanged. Unset in the goldens.
Writes network_dd_fractional.csv, the input of every DD/AR grade (grade_ddfrac, the ref-free re-reference tools); costly at scale. Pinned on in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: the primary DD/AR grading instrument; every DD verdict on record is stated against it

knobs.why: Seeded per-epoch subsample cap on DD-trace pairs (0 = unlimited); unbounded, the trace cost 20-40 min/epoch at 305 stations. Goldens pin 2000.
knobs.posture_why: unbounded dd-frac cost 20-40 min/epoch at 305 sta; set 500, or 2000 on decimated tiers

knobs.why: Trace-only epoch stride of the DD trace, not fingerprinted; goldens keep the default 1, the validated value.
Reference-satellite rule of the DD trace (lowest | oldest); oldest is quieter as traced but 2-3x above the ref-free grade. Goldens keep lowest under a documented continuity exception.
knobs.posture_why: arm oldest only when the as-traced CSV must stand alone; grades use the ref-free instruments

knobs.why: Writes the (cons, signal, sat) to anchor-station map of the prioritized phase datum, the only record of the anchor partition; trace-only. Pinned on in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: the anchor partition is untestable without the (cons,signal,sat)->anchor map; no other artifact carries it

knobs.why: Epoch decimation, estimation-relevant and fingerprinted: n=1 for any graded run, n=2 the 60 s dev tier, n=10 emission mechanics only (carry prediction invalid). Goldens 1.
knobs.posture_why: n=1 for decisive grading, n=2 the 60 s dev tier; at n=10 the carry prediction is invalid (33 pct/ep refloat)

knobs.why: RTF-3 live multi-station epoch source (per-station lanes, wait-budget aligner, bounded queue); 17 unit tests, but the end-to-end ON validation its card makes field-blocking was never run.
Aligner wait from an epoch's first arrival to dispatch (design range 0.3 to 1 s); read only by the streaming front-end.
Station floor to dispatch a streamed epoch (2 is the between-station estimability floor); read only by the streaming front-end.
Drops a streamed epoch lacking the clock-datum station before it takes a queue slot; read only by the streaming front-end.
Bound of the epoch-granular solve queue (overflow drops the oldest epoch); read only by the streaming front-end.
Nominal observation cadence used to bucket stream arrivals into epochs (uniform across streams, 1 s MSM); read only by the streaming front-end.
Aligner memory bound on undispatched epoch buckets (oldest stale bucket dropped and counted); read only by the streaming front-end.
Derives the LLI slip bit from MSM lock-time regressions through one station-keyed tracker (RTB-3 reuse); changes slip detection, meaningful only on streaming lanes.
Wall-clock cadence of the streaming front-end heartbeat log line (lanes live, epochs dispatched and dropped, queue depth); log only.
Refines the SH-VTEC slant supply to the closed-loop consumer; inert on the posture (estimate_iono_sh off in both goldens, so no SH model exists), and AB1 rules the SH consumer constraint KEEP_OFF.
Per-tier QC flag counters plus network_flag_rates.csv and network_run_summary.csv at run end; solve-inert; pinned on in both goldens. End-of-run writer, so a killed run writes nothing.
knobs.posture_why: O(1) counters and two run-end files; the check that the armed QC tiers fire at their designed alpha.

knobs.why: One-shot read-only dump of the full arrowhead normal equations at the Nth processed epoch; solve-inert; -1 (off) in both goldens.
Reduced-RHS class attribution dumps to logs/rhs_attrib/ at a chosen TOW; diagnostics only, not fingerprinted; card ICF instrument A used it; unset in the goldens.
Number of consecutive epochs dumped from the armed TOW (default 2, a pre-break/break pair; card ICF used 4).
Flight recorder: a QC trip dumps its own RHS attribution; solve byte-identical on FT63 leg 19; pinned on in both goldens and listed by RF-1 as ON-path telemetry.
knobs.posture_why: A trip names its own injector in the run; scoped on memory (25.4 MB retained frame at 63 sta, self-disables above 128 sta).

knobs.why: Measure-only redundancy and testability sweep every Nth epoch (no weight, state or decision touched); stride 10 in both goldens, where it hosts the armed mdb, block_baarda and congruence_screen riders.
Uncheckable-row threshold r_i < eps for the census and the MDB join recount; loader clamps values outside (0,1); default 0.05 in the goldens.
Centred-deviation threshold for the uncheckable-row cross-flag; loader clamps non-positive values to 1000; default in the goldens.
Pivot floor (times the median) for the INC-2 orphaned-state census; loader warns at or below the kernel's 1e-12 PD floor; default 1e-8 in the goldens.
Free-tier escalation threshold that triggers a targeted single-station sweep (0 = off); measure-only; unset in the goldens.
Per-(station, satellite, class) census event rate limit in sweep passes; default 20 in the goldens.
Common-mode-removed prefit row census; 7.6 ms per epoch at 63 stations with the solve byte-identical; pinned on in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: Measured 7.6 ms/epoch at 63 sta, solve byte-identical; the only always-on pre-solve row screen.

knobs.why: Event threshold on the centred standardized prefit deviation; loader clamps non-positive values to 1000; default in the goldens.
Data-class domain for census events (default code,sh,other; obs_phase excluded because a phase innovation is arc-specific); no config sets it.
Per-(station, satellite, class) census event rate limit in processed epochs; default 20 in the goldens.
Solve-affecting weight cap on 1e3-sigma prefit rows; the RF-3 arm at 1000 was null on the re-founded posture (9 rows capped in 6 h); unset in both goldens.
Data-class domain of the fuse (default code,sh); card NOM2 moved the class meanings (clock-only code rows in, station-unique phase rows out); no config sets it.
Measure-only seed-birth tripwire on rows of per-LOS states born this epoch (0 = off); runs the census walk; unset in the goldens, set by one live config.
Topology ledger events (tie-row, row-kind and shared-column registry deltas) on the census walk; solve byte-identical on FT63 leg 19; pinned on in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: Rides the census walk, events only; makes the decouple and re-couple edges of standing invariant 7 visible.

knobs.why: Retains the previous epoch so a trip also dumps the pre-trip frame (default true, 25.4 MB at 63 sta); self-disables above rhs_attrib_prev_max_stations.
Station-count ceiling above which previous-epoch retention self-disables with a one-shot warning (25.4 MB per frame at 63 stations); default 128 covers both 59/60-station beds.
Absolute product-referenced code screen refusing corrupt channels at arc birth (BSHM00ISR G07, G16); gates 2 to 4 PASS; solve-affecting and pinned on in both goldens.
Station-median-centred |z| bound of the screen; default 1000 m validated (identical reject set at 300 and 3000 m); non-positive or non-finite values clamp to the default.
Minimum satellites for the station median the screen centres on; golden runs use the default 4; values below 2 clamp to 4.
Clean epochs a rejected channel needs before readmission; golden runs use the default 5; values below 1 clamp to 1.
Station guard: above this fraction of a station's channels failing, a station event fires instead of rejecting off a corrupt centre; golden runs use 0.5; clamped to (0,1).
Measure-only admission census columns in the epoch-status and manifest traces; NetworkRunContext resolves it as adm_trace or adm_screen, so the golden pin is implied by the armed screen.
Re-entry vet closed both re-entry classes on two pre-refound field legs, but healthy and refused |z| sit only 3.5x apart and the 24 h arm never ran; requires adm_screen, default off.
Absent screened epochs that make a return a re-entry; default 1 (any missing epoch), clamped to at least 1.
Length of the post-re-entry vet window in epochs; default 8; negative clamps to 0 (no window, so the census trigger can never fire).
Vet bound as a fraction of adm_bound_m; the shipped 0.2 (200 m) refused G16 at its return epoch and admitted 70 of 72 re-entries; clamped to (0,1].
Lets a prefit-census obs_code exceedance refuse a re-entry independently of the vet bound (slow-ramp class); needs the prefit walk, otherwise counted as revet_census_absent.
Strict variant: a re-entry is withheld until it re-earns admission through the heal path; erased the G16 excursion on the card's legs, not the shipped default.
One CSV row per processed epoch recording the disposition (emitted, or why skipped) and sigma0; O(epochs) cost, solve-inert; pinned on in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: cost is O(epochs), not O(stations); the only record of why an epoch was skipped

knobs.why: Writes network_sh_spectrum.csv: smallest eigenvalues of the reduced shared normal and their per-family eigenvector mass; one eigensolve per emitted epoch, measure-only, fingerprint-safe.
Mode-detail stride (default 60 traced epochs) for the companion mode CSV; 0 leaves the mode file closed.
Robust post-fit variance factor per emitted epoch, appended as columns of network_epoch_status.csv (inert without trace_epoch_status); measure-only; pinned on in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: with raim_within_epoch off the emit path carries no post-fit statistic; costs one residual pass per emitted epoch

knobs.why: Per-station, satellite and signal robust post-fit pools to network_pf_keyed.csv on the P1-4 pass; trace-only, fingerprint-safe, pinned on in both goldens.
Signed per-(station, satellite, signal) post-fit residual rows to network_pf_rows.csv from the P1-4 pass; trace-only, fingerprint-safe, pinned on in both goldens.
Per-station local-block audit (rank, condition, smallest eigenpairs, ZWD information) to network_station_block.csv; measure-only via const accessors, fingerprint-safe; not in the goldens.
Names the null local column behind each addStation PD rejection as a network_events.csv row; eigen read only on rejected blocks, solve byte-identical; pinned on in both goldens.
Held-out consumer writes logs/closed_loop_sat_trace.csv per satellite and signal (applied corrections, declarations, residuals, states); measure-only; pinned on in both goldens.
Channel-scoped discontinuity marks (card PBT fix B) failed bar B1 (44 against at most 20); PBT superseded by the PBH hold; no config sets it.
Emit-side phase-bias hold per generation; all five PBH-1 bars pass with the solve byte-identical; pinned in both goldens, scoped to the float vehicle with a closed-loop consumer.
knobs.posture_why: holds each emitted phase bias per generation: removes 0.0467 m of field wire PB error; all five PBH-1 bars pass; solve untouched

knobs.why: Gap that starts a new hold generation; the default 300 s is the graded value and also sets the signal roster's hold horizon.
Level-aware hold armed interim with the exact update by card EXL; pinned in both goldens; valid only with a precise a priori clock and refused under sp3_brdc_clock (NBP).
knobs.regime: val("network.ambiguity_vehicle", "level") == "float_kf" and on("network.closed_loop.enable") and on("network.emit_pb_hold") and val("network.apriori_source", "sp3") != "brdc_rts" and not on("network.emit_pb_hold_smoothed")
knobs.posture_why: keeps the exact update's level motion off the phase wire: field hour 1 3.878 to 0.108 m; interim, precise a priori clock only

knobs.why: Selects the a priori orbit and clock source (sp3, brdc_rts, sp3_brdc_clock); brdc_rts is scoped to the self-sufficient RT service; goldens use sp3; NBP's sp3_brdc_clock landed off.
knobs.regime: rt and not (on("network.estimate_sat_code_bias") and not on("network.estimate_iono_sh"))
knobs.posture_why: self-sufficient RT service needs brdc_rts: float 2.84 m vs sp3 2.76 m (3 sta, 121 ep); unvalidated at scale

knobs.why: Card SMH's smoothed hold, built and not armed (C1W census loss from hour 3 on the precise-clock posture); kept because NBP's sp3_brdc_clock posture and SCL2B's X2b require it.
Exact coupling time update (card CTU) armed by card EXL with guard space phase and rank_gate_tol 1e-11; pinned in both goldens; fresh convergence only.
knobs.regime: val("network.ambiguity_vehicle", "level") == "float_kf" and on("network.phase_leveling") and on("network.carry_coupling_time_update") and on("network.shared_carry_full_cov")
knobs.posture_why: keeps young-arc ambiguity information each epoch: sim level 0.16 to 0.02 m; ships with the phase-clock hold; fresh convergence only

knobs.why: Folds each station's RXCB-DATUM rows before the PD test, curing the amputation (PD rejections to 0); in the RF-0hv posture and both goldens since GRB; replay fixed by RPD.
Per-epoch section-timer breakdown, measured byte-identical on and off; the only per-epoch cost attribution; pinned in both goldens.
knobs.posture_why: only per-epoch cost attribution; measured byte-identical on and off; every perf claim needs it

knobs.why: Writes the service-health heartbeat row every N s of content time, the only mid-run-flushed CSV; solve-inert; both goldens set 300 s.
knobs.posture_why: 60 to 300 s: the only mid-run-flushed CSV, so a crashed or zombied run keeps its health telemetry

knobs.why: Size-based rotation of the unbounded service CSVs (trace, solution, service health); 0 is off and byte-identical; solve-inert.
Number of rolled CSV generations kept when rotation is on; clamped to at least 1.
Cold-start URA floor ramp for consumer down-weighting; wired and fingerprinted, set in no config and never graded; at 0 the ramp is inert (RF-IGN).
Lift horizon of the cold-start URA ramp; inert unless the floor is above 0.
Master path of the producer snapshot and warm resume; seams are a re-founding add-back (fresh convergence only today) and the goldens set no path.
Snapshot rewrite cadence in seconds of product time (default 10, clamped above 0); inert without the path.
Serializes the carry_invariant DD carry for warm resume; forced off without carry_invariant, which the float vehicle superseded; GPS+Galileo at 305 sta read negative.
Diagonal-only Pz in the carry_invariant blob; forced off without state_snapshot_carry, whose vehicle the float vehicle superseded; the GPS+Galileo ordering was never adjudicated.

Writes each chord's linearization DD into the carry_invariant blob (RS-2); disarmed without state_snapshot_carry; its reader, the RS-2 re-base (resume_carry_rebase), was deleted by card RKD, so the rows are written, parsed and counted only; pinned only on the retired field golden.
Makes any refused warm resume a hard run error instead of a silent cold start; inert without a snapshot path, so out of regime on the cold goldens; the seam add-back needs it.
knobs.posture_why: a refused resume otherwise cold-starts silently; mandatory in every same-snapshot A/B

knobs.why: Write-only per-snapshot copies (<path>.ep<NNNN>), solve-inert; the cross-run branch-z metric it fed is retired, but resume legs still cut mid-run seeds from it (cards AGT, FCF).
Write half of resume_frame_restore (anchor incumbents, Q3 clock anchor, CLK-R frame rows); products byte-identical; sim-validated only (leg E), never on a field warm resume of the current posture.
Write half of resume_coupling_restore (Card-1 regressors, about 37x the snapshot size); loader requires the frame capture; sim-validated only (leg E), no field warm resume on the current posture.
Write-only datum memories (eq34 tree, time-linked code-bias map) for resume_datum_restore; products byte-identical; graded on the retired Card-4 field seed; out of regime on the cold goldens.
knobs.posture_why: without it a resumed run re-elects the phase datum and re-seeds the code-bias datum at the seam

knobs.why: Write-only emit-layer rows (the re-base frame) for resume_emit_restore; products byte-identical; RS-5 closed the 17.7 m phase-bias seam step; out of regime without a snapshot path.
knobs.posture_why: without it a warm resume cold-starts the emit layer and re-realizes every phase-bias level (17.7 m p50, field)

knobs.why: Write-only station-layer rows (rx-CB carry, per-LOS deviation carry; empty when those carries are off) for resume_station_restore; products byte-identical; out of regime without a snapshot path.
knobs.posture_why: without it a warm resume restarts the rx-CB and per-LOS deviation carries cold (the a00 seam transient)

knobs.why: Write-only canonical-signal latch rows for resume_signal_canon_restore; products byte-identical; RS-8 cut seam chord births 64 to 1 under the count rule, since replaced by the priority rule (CSL).
knobs.posture_why: without it a warm resume re-decides station canonical signals and re-births their ambiguities at the seam

knobs.why: Write-only rx-CB linearization-point rows beside the station capture (disarmed without it) for resume_rxcb_lin_restore; RS-9 cut the resumed withhold share 26.3 % to 9.8 %; products byte-identical.
knobs.posture_why: without it the restored rx-CB carry is judged against a re-seeded x_lin and 11 extra stations are refused all leg

knobs.why: Writes network_events.csv, one long-format row per discrete QC, datum or gate action; solve-inert; pinned true in both goldens and the identity sink for the census, admission and RF-PD instruments.
knobs.posture_why: names every QC and datum action (pivot handover, retro bumps otherwise silent); census and admission identities need it

knobs.why: Writes network_zwd.csv (per-station ZWD and datum-conditioned formal sigma each emitted epoch); solve-inert; on in both goldens.
Writes network_sat_bias_states.csv, the satellite code-bias formal sigma the B record lacks; byte-identical when off; on in both goldens.
Writes network_rx_states.csv (receiver clock and receiver code-bias states with datum-conditioned sigma); solve-inert; on in both goldens.
Writes network_station_residuals.csv from the RAIM pool (phase cell maximum); solve-inert; on in both goldens; header-only on carry_invariant lineages without raim_carry_invariant.
Per-row Baarda redundancy census, solve bit-identical; the n_sta <= 50 regime keeps it off the 58 and 60 station goldens (14397 rows/epoch and 2.1x wall measured at 305 sta).
knobs.regime: val("network.raim", False) and (val("network.raim_carry_invariant", False) or (val("network.phase_leveling", False) and not val("network.carry_invariant", False))) and n_sta <= 50
knobs.posture_why: the only per-signal r_i artifact; solve-neutral; arm for residual-structure work at <= 50 stations
